title: Clean Lines, Flat Color
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Rewrite for feeling and message after the collector approved the pilot room (Skulls and Shadows) on 2026-10-16. Every work was inspected again from the published WebP at 1200 px in room order and as one wall. Facts come from data/gallery.json and curation/analysis/strokes/measures.json; readings rest on the pictures, the record and the artist's sourced words. No model inference calls were made; the text was written and image-checked by the assistant. Captions and readings from the 2026-10-15 text are kept except where the feeling changes the one thing to see.
scope: The owned subset: the 20 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Sparer faces on flat color, and the sparer they get, the lighter they feel. The twenty works in this room are drawn with less: a cartoon head in a few strokes, a mask of beads and petals, a diagram of a face in colored line with the ground showing through. Most are from the first four months of 2022, the same months as the skulls and the quiet portraits. This is the artist taking a breath between them.

The line does different things here. On some works it is a cartoon outline, thick and black, with a flat color inside. On others it is a diagram, drawing each part of the face as a shape and leaving the rest to the ground. And on one, the grey face with glasses, it is eight loops and nothing else. Whatever the line does, the ground does the rest, and the grounds are the brightest in the wing: lime, orange, yellow, teal. The color carries the mood, and the mood is a shrug and a grin.

In the earlier rooms the ground is filled or scribbled until the square is full. Here the drawing sits on it like a sticker. Half the canvas is often left bare, and that bareness is the feeling of the room: nothing to hide, nothing to bury, a face put down and left alone. It is the one room in the Faces where the teeth are nearly always a joke.

chapters.title: Cartoon Heads
chapters.opening: December 2021 to February 2022. A scribble mask on white, then a run of cartoon heads: goggle eyes on lime, a black head on red, a face with a peace sign. The line gets thick and the faces get funny.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #34
works.text: An oval mask on white in cyan, pink and green scribble, with two eyes looking up, red lips, and a grin of white teeth, drawn on December 3, 2021, the tangle's method on the bare ground of this room, and the first face here to look pleased about nothing in particular.
works.caption: An oval mask on white in cyan, pink and green scribble, two eyes looking up, red lips, white teeth.
works.reading: The oval is tilted to the left and filled with scribble that gets denser at the eyes. The lips are a red shape with white teeth inside and a black line between them. The eyes are two white ovals with dark pupils rolled up.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #64
works.text: A yellow-green face on lime, hatched in yellow and blue, with two goggle eyes in white boxes under a dark brow and a row of white teeth hanging from the chin. The face is a cartoon: a thick outline, a flat color, two boxes for eyes. The teeth hang below the jaw as a row of white pegs, like the pale head in the painted room, but drawn in line. The cartoon run begins here. The same hanging teeth that made the painted head a saint make this one a goof, and the difference is nothing but the ground: lime instead of a glow.
works.caption: A yellow-green face on lime, goggle eyes in white boxes under a dark brow, teeth hanging from the chin.
works.reading: The goggles are two white rounded boxes joined at the center, each with a small dark pupil and blue around it. The brow is a dark bar of hatching. The ear at the left is a loop. The teeth hang from the lower edge of the face in a row of six.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #68
works.text: A grey mask inside a ring of yellow dots, with two white-dot eyes in dark boxes, a row of pink dots on the brow, and a mouth drawn as a grate of dark bars. Around the yellow dots, rings of grey scallops run to the edges like the rim of a shield. The mask is drawn in soft grey and teal with thin orange line, and it is the most ordered drawing in the room: every mark is a dot, a ring or a bar. The grate of a mouth is the one unfriendly thing in it, and the shield around it says why: this face is armour, and it is calm because nothing gets in.
works.caption: A grey mask ringed with yellow dots, white-dot eyes in dark boxes, a mouth like a grate of bars.
works.reading: The yellow dots are drawn at even spacing in a circle just inside the frame. The eyes are two dark boxes with concentric rings and a white dot at the center. The grate is a box of dark vertical bars at the bottom. Spikes of orange line rise from the brow.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #77
works.text: A black cartoon head on red, with two white eye boxes and small pupils, a red nose, a wide grin of white teeth, and white marks at the corners like motion lines, a face that has just heard good news.
works.caption: A black cartoon head on red, white eye boxes, a red nose, a wide grin, white marks at the corners.
works.reading: The head is drawn in black with blue and orange scribble inside, and a thick black outline. The eyes are two white boxes with black pupils looking left. The grin is a red mouth with white blocks. The white marks at the four corners are short fat strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #81
works.text: A mask head on yellow filled with colored scribble, two white slots for eyes with red slits inside, and a grimace of white teeth in a red mouth, the first face here that is not enjoying itself, and it is still on yellow.
works.caption: A mask head on yellow filled with colored scribble, two white slots for eyes with red slits, white teeth.
works.reading: The eyes are two long white rectangles with a red bar in each, one higher than the other. The nose is a dark bar. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth tilted to the right. A small ear loops at the left.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #82
works.text: A black head and shoulders on pink and purple, with a yellow X in one eye, an orange X in the other, small white fangs, and a black hand raised at the right in a peace sign. The figure is one flat black shape outlined in cyan, and the X marks are the only color on it. Seventy-four strokes. It is the one work in the room with a gesture, and the gesture settles the room's question: crossed eyes, fangs, and two fingers up for peace. The threat and the joke are the same figure, and it is waving at you.
works.caption: A black head and shoulders on pink, X marks for eyes, small fangs, a hand raised in a peace sign.
works.reading: The hand is drawn as a black shape with two fingers up, outlined in cyan like the head. The X marks sit in white boxes, yellow at the left and orange at the right. The mouth is a small box with white fangs. The purple band behind the head is a stripe of darker ground.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #83
works.caption: Dripping brown and black blocks on peach, edged in white, a small horned creature with an X eye below.
works.reading: The blocks are drawn as thick dark shapes with white edges and black drips running down from them, like a fist or a hand. The creature at the corner is a small dark head with a red X and a spiky crest. Soft discs of orange and lilac sit behind.

chapters.title: Masks and Emblems
chapters.opening: February 19 to March 6, 2022. A skull with a crown for an eye, an owl, a gold blob with star eyes, a skull in profile, a sun of petals and beads, and an angular head in a haze. Emblems, not people: things you could stamp on a flag.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #89
works.text: A cartoon skull in white line under cyan rays, with a yellow crown in a box for one eye and a window of red grid for the other, a grille of white teeth and lime fingers at the side, a skull that has made it to royalty and is pleased to be seen.
works.caption: A cartoon skull in white line under cyan rays, one eye a yellow crown, the other a red grid.
works.reading: The rays are thick cyan strokes fanning from the upper left over a grey and tan ground. The crown eye is a yellow zigzag in a box at the upper right; the window eye is a red grid over yellow at the left. The teeth are white bars in a red box.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #93
works.text: An owl head on orange with pointed ears, two green ringed eyes crossed with red, and a grille of white bars for a mouth, drawn in black, blue and yellow hatching: the box-head mouth on a bird, and the bird looks startled to have it.
works.caption: An owl head on orange with pointed ears, two green ringed eyes crossed with red, a grille of white bars.
works.reading: The eyes are large green discs in black rings, each with a red X across it. The ears are two black points. The mouth is a dark box with white bars. The hatching around the head is blue, yellow and lilac in short strokes like feathers.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #95
works.text: A gold blob of a head curved like a banana on green diagonal stripes, with two red star eyes and a grin of white fangs, the silliest shape in the wing, grinning like it knows.
works.caption: A gold blob of a head curved like a banana on green stripes, red star eyes, a grin of fangs.
works.reading: The shape bends from the upper left down to a point at the lower right. The eyes are two red X marks in rings, one larger. The grin is a red mouth with white triangles. The stripes behind run diagonally in two greens.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #98
works.text: A skull in profile on teal, drawn in white and black line, with a sunflower for an eye, a crest of yellow loops, and a grid of thin lines over the whole square, a skull on graph paper, measured and cheerful.
works.caption: A skull in profile on teal in white and black line, a sunflower for an eye, yellow loops on top.
works.reading: The skull faces right with its jaw at the lower right. The sunflower eye is a ring of orange petals around a red center. The crest is a row of yellow loops along the top of the head. Thin red, white and blue lines cross the teal like a grid.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #102
works.text: A sun of a mask on dark green: a round face ringed with yellow petals, each with a dot, and a row of red spikes along the top like a crown. One eye is a white dot in a dark socket, the other a ring with a white center. The mouth is white teeth in a dark oval. Beads of blue, pink and yellow run around the face. With 347 recorded strokes it is the most worked drawing in the room, and the only one with every part in its place. It is a sun that has been up too long: the petals are tidy, the crown is on, and the mouth under them is open in something between a smile and a groan. The room's emblem of effort, drawn as a face that has had enough of being an emblem.
works.caption: A sun of a mask on dark green ringed with yellow petals, red spikes on top, white teeth below.
works.reading: The petals are drawn as rounded leaves in yellow and olive with a dot at the tip of each. The spikes are red and white strokes standing up from the brow. The two eyes do not match: the left is a dark socket with a white dot, the right a ring with lashes. The beads are small colored circles in rows.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #105
works.text: An angular head on a neck, drawn in black, white and blue line over a haze of soft gold and brown discs, its face a few straight strokes, the quiet portraits' haze with a cartoon drawn on it, and the one head here that is thinking.
works.caption: An angular head on a neck drawn in black, white and blue line over a haze of soft gold discs.
works.reading: The head is a box with a slanted top, and the face inside it is drawn in short straight lines: a brow, a nose, a mouth. The neck is a column of lines at the bottom. The discs behind are gold, orange and brown.

chapters.title: Line Diagrams
chapters.opening: March 24 to April 16, 2022. Seven faces drawn as diagrams, from eight grey loops to a machine of rings and teeth on teal. The line stops pretending to be anything but line.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #113
works.text: A face in eight grey loops on grey: two circles for glasses, a curl for a nose, a spiral for a mouth, and a cluster of pink and orange bubbles for hair. Fifty-eight strokes, each one a quick mark, make the sparest drawing in the whole collection. Nothing is filled and nothing is scribbled. It is the sparest face in the Faces, and the most contented. The spiral mouth could be a smile or a hum. After four months of teeth, here is a face with none, and it needs none.
works.caption: A face in a few grey loops on grey, two circles for glasses, a spiral mouth, pink bubbles for hair.
works.reading: The glasses are two circles joined by a short arc, each with a small loop inside for an eye. The nose is a hook under the bridge. The mouth is a spiral with a dark center at the lower right. The hair is overlapping pink and orange discs with dark arcs.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #114
works.text: A head of dark red scribble on grey with two yellow X eyes, a blue bar falling from the face like a tear, and an orange band across the top, the one sad drawing in the room, and the sadness is a single blue stripe.
works.caption: A head of dark red scribble on grey, two yellow X eyes, a soft blue bar falling like a tear.
works.reading: The scribble is black, red and yellow in tight loops, with the hair hanging at both sides. The X eyes are yellow with orange around them. The blue bar is a soft vertical stroke from the eye to the bottom. Three red dots and three yellow ones sit at the corners.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #115
works.text: A flat face on yellow, striped in blue, green and orange, with two pink X marks for eyes, four small dots across the brow, and a thick white outline with rays. At the lower right a small red face on a stick looks on with its own X eyes. The stripes run down the face and drip at the chin. The outline is drawn with short strokes standing out from it like a child's sun. The big face is solemn, with its mouth shut and its eyes crossed out, and the little face on the stick beside it is grinning. The picture has brought its own heckler.
works.caption: A flat striped face on yellow, pink X eyes, a white outline with rays, a small red face beside it.
works.reading: The stripes are vertical bands of blue, green, orange and red, drawn soft so they blend. The X marks are pink loops in dark sockets. The dots on the brow are yellow with dark centers. The small face at the right has a crest of spikes and a dripping red stem.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #118
works.text: A face on navy drawn in blue, pink and yellow line: a ringed eye in a box, a box with an X, a yellow crest, and a long white zigzag of teeth across the lower face, the kit of parts floated on dark, and the zigzag is a laugh.
works.caption: A face on navy in colored line, a ringed eye, an X eye, a long white zigzag of teeth.
works.reading: The ringed eye at the left is blue rings in a blue box with a white center. The X eye at the right is a blue box with a pink X. The teeth run the full width as a row of white triangles with a second row above. A yellow crest sits on the left eye.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #119
works.text: A face on olive in white, orange and blue line, with a ringed eye and a spiky eye, two rows of hanging teeth, and a chain of white teeth across the bottom, more teeth than face, and all of them cheerful.
works.caption: A face on olive in white, orange and blue line, a ringed eye and a spiky eye, chains of teeth.
works.reading: The eyes sit in boxes at the top, the left a ring with a cross and the right a ring with spikes. The teeth hang in two rows of white pegs, and a third row at the bottom is drawn as a chain of linked ovals.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #120
works.caption: Blocks of colored line on teal, a bar of white teeth at the bottom, a pink chain down the right.
works.reading: The blocks are boxes of black, red, pink and yellow line stacked at angles, with scribble inside some of them. The teeth are white blocks in a long box at the lower left. The pink chain is a row of small loops along the right edge.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #123
works.text: A face on teal with two eyes like propellers in rings, a red ball for a nose, a bar of white teeth in a red box, and a crown of yellow and blue ovals. Everything is drawn in line, and every part is a separate shape: a ring, a box, a ball, a bar. Three weeks after the face in eight grey loops, this is the diagram with all its parts filled in. The last work in the room, from April 16, 2022. The propeller eyes spin and the red nose is a clown's, and the whole machine is built to be looked at and liked. The room ends on the kit assembled as a toy, which is where the Faces began.
works.caption: A face on teal with propeller eyes in rings, a red ball nose, white teeth, a crown of yellow ovals.
works.reading: The propeller eyes are four blades in a ring, drawn in blue and white with a red center. The nose is a dark red circle. The teeth are white blocks in a red box with a red zigzag below. The crown is a row of yellow ovals outlined in blue along the top.

closing: Look again at the face in eight grey loops, and then at the face of propellers and teeth on teal. Both are line on a flat ground. One leaves almost everything out and is at peace with it. The other draws every part and still leaves the ground showing. That is the range of this room: from a face that needs nothing to a face that has everything and is still not sure it is a face.
